derivation: Long qty 10 opened cost-free at 100 with stop 95. Four invalid actions: moving the stop DOWN to 90 widens it; moving it to 150 crosses the mark (not protective); widen_stop and increase_position are not permitted actions. All four must be rejected with recorded invalid_action events and MUST NOT change cash (10000, no fees charged), the stop (95), or the open quantity (10).
